decisions.reason: The air fin cooler sits close to the core offer, the firm is growing and has slack, and there is no evidence of a shortfall against aspirations that would trigger search for other uses of the resources.
This condenser fits the core portfolio, but it overlaps with Product C, which leaves a modest chance of consolidation; with growth and slack the firm is likely to keep it.
Its near-duplicate positioning with B makes it the more likely candidate for rationalisation, but without a performance shortfall there is little pressure to drop it.
The tube liner supports the strategic lifecycle-service business at low marginal cost, so it likely meets aspirations and is retained.
The customized air cooler line matches the firm's integrated-solutions strategy and spreads risk across several models, making it very likely to stay.
The tube end repair inserts strengthen aftermarket service revenue with little resource use, so there is no reason to drop them while the firm is expanding.
